headline: Fintech OPay Debuts on NYSE in $4 Billion IPO
summary: SoftBank-backed fintech OPay debuted on the New York Stock Exchange, offering 16 million American depositary shares at $19 each in an initial public offering valuing the digital financial services provider at about $4 billion.
why: Cross-border listings of emerging-market fintech providers offer a gauge of international investor appetite for digital financial services and venture-backed growth assets.

impacts.name: OPay
impacts.why: A successful public market listing establishes an open-market valuation and provides growth capital.
